Bihar Alcohol Ban Failed to Curb Women's Violence, Report Suggests Revocation

A study by the National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER) suggests that Bihar should revoke its prohibition policy on alcohol. The report indicates the ban has not reduced crimes against women and has instead fueled an illicit liquor trade. The study also proposes that restoring liquor excise duty could increase state revenues by 15 percent. The findings were reported by multiple centrist outlets.
